text: Muhammad Ayub Sheikh is a Pakistani politician who served as a member of the National Assembly of Pakistan from 2008 to 2013. He was elected in the 2008 Pakistani general election as a candidate of the Muttahida Qaumi Movement (MQM) from Constituency NA-254 (Karachi-XVI). During the election, he received 132,648 votes and defeated Syed Suhail Abrar, who ran as a candidate for the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP).
